name: mcxx-warm
description: A warm start builds no module (A1.4.4, E-LS-1): run cold, then again with the same --workspace-dir and --cache-dir and --expect-warm. The second session navigates across the program's modules, and every published module file -- std, the program's interface and its partition -- is the one the first session left: none rebuilt, none added. W0 waits, in both sessions, until the core engine has prepared the program (main.cpp's diagnostics come from it once its modules are built): the native engine answers W1 on its own, so without it the first session could end before the core engine built anything.
